issues_detected.description: Release datasets lack keywords, purposes, creators, page and composition fields; descriptive metadata lives only on the undeclared top-level mapping, which is not inherited under the collection interpretation.
issues_detected.recommendation: Declare the top-level record as a Dataset (conforms_to_class) or repeat keywords, purposes and creators on each release.

issues_detected.description: October 2025 and June 2026 releases list only ZIP archives with no inner formats, byte sizes or download URLs; June 2026 files carry no descriptions or dimensional metadata.
issues_detected.recommendation: List inner file formats, byte sizes and download URLs for each release archive.

issues_detected.description: No release records funders or creators with affiliations; the June 2026 citation and DOI identify the same resource, so no release documents a second distinct reference.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record funders/creators with affiliations and the related preprints on each release.

issues_detected.description: No release records ethics review, human-subject status, deidentification or cell-line donor/population information.
issues_detected.recommendation: Carry the ethics, deidentification and cell-line donor statements onto each release.

issues_detected.description: Releases give only a bare license string; no IP restrictions, confidentiality classification, governance contact or intended/prohibited uses at release level.
issues_detected.recommendation: Use license_and_use_terms with full terms, IP holders and use guidance per release.

issues_detected.description: Releases declare no schema conformance, processing tools, collection fields, timeframes or lineage; provenance-graph files in June 2025 are listed but not represented.
issues_detected.recommendation: Declare RO-Crate conformance and collection/processing lineage on each release.

issues_detected.description: Release units have version and DOI but no maintainers, update plan or preservation commitment.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add maintainers and the maintenance/preservation plan to each release.

issues_detected.description: Version strings disagree with citation versions (1.4 vs V1; 2.1 vs V2 in two releases); all four releases share created_on 2025-02-27; the data-releases page and Dataverse disagree on the June 2026 release year (record documents and resolves it).
issues_detected.recommendation: Use the Dataverse citation version consistently and give release-specific creation dates.

issues_detected.description: IF protein counts differ across releases and summaries (563, 464, 523); the June 2025 file_count 21 exceeds the 10 files listed. Both are acknowledged in source_caveats.
issues_detected.recommendation: List all files or state the unlisted ones explicitly.

issues_detected.description: File ids are minted cm4ai.org fragment URIs (e.g. https://cm4ai.org/#release-2026-06-files) that are not resolvable identifiers; release DOIs (10.18130, UVA Dataverse) are well formed.
issues_detected.recommendation: Use resolvable Dataverse file identifiers where available.

issues_detected.description: At collection level, 'derived from commercially available de-identified human cell lines' is recorded as a known bias although it is a provenance statement; deidentification is asserted while human-subject involvement is false. Neither affects release-unit scores.
issues_detected.recommendation: Move provenance statements out of known_biases.

issues_detected.description: Creator name 'Ballllosero Navarro F' (also in the June 2026 citation) appears to contain a transcription error; not verifiable from the record.
issues_detected.recommendation: Check the creator name against the Dataverse author list.

semantic_insights: The record has no conforms_to_class and four nonempty resources, so it is scored as a collection of four release datasets; the rich top-level metadata (creators, funders, ethics, uses, biases, collection protocol) is not inherited, which drives most low scores.
Each item score is the minimum across the four releases; the October 2025 and June 2026 releases are the weakest units (ZIP-only file lists, June 2026 without file descriptions).
Top-level content (not scored here) is detailed and well caveated: NIH award 1OT2OD032742-01 matches the NIH OT2 pattern, ORCIDs are well formed, and release DOIs share the 10.18130 Dataverse prefix.
Declaring the top level as a Dataset (conforms_to_class) or repeating key metadata on each release would let the documentation be credited under this instrument.
